title: Mouldy Food

sources.title: Bag of Moulding
markers: | description = '''Bag of Moulding''' is a [[Miscellaneous#Containers|Container]] that will rot any food that is put inside of it.

summary: Food transformed by the Bag of Moulding keeps its original Camp Supplies value.

fields.Use: Spend it for Long Rest without ill effects. The tooltip says Poisoned for 10 turns, but it cannot be eaten directly.
fields.Creation: Place food into the Bag of Moulding received from Akabi.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
